summary: LinkStack is a self-hosted platform that lets you aggregate multiple URLs and social media profiles onto a single customisable landing page. It provides a centralised administrator interface to manage links as an alternative to proprietary services like Linktree. The project is open source and built using PHP and Docker.
goodFor: It suits individuals or organisations who want full control over their public link-in-bio page without relying on third-party SaaS providers.
watchOut: The project exhibits slowing maintenance activity and competes in a space dominated by mature, cloud-hosted alternatives. You will also need to manage your own hosting, DNS, and uptime.
deployNotes: Deployment typically involves running the provided Docker container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination. You will also need to ensure persistent storage is configured for any user data and database files.
